evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: A multi-step agent task fails when a single tool it needs is missing, yet the tools an agent may need are too many to list: the roughly 8,200 tools on the platform we study have definitions that together exceed the context window of any model we evaluate.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On ToolRet, Tool Recommendation places every tool a query needs in the top ten 57% more often than BM25, a lexical ranking that commercial tool search offers, and compares favorably with published systems up to nine times its size.
